summary: Iteration 50 — Re-verification of i18n SEO fixes from iter 49. RESULTS: 2 of 3 prior HIGH/CRITICAL fixes verified, 1 still partially broken, plus 1 newly-exposed bug. PASSED: (a) ProviderECard now derives lang/canonical from window.location.pathname — /provider/ renders html lang=en + canonical /provider/, /proveedor/ renders html lang=es + canonical /proveedor/, both under any localStorage state (verified by clearing/forcing localStorage to opposite lang and re-loading). (b) I18nContext.detectInitialLang now respects ES_PATH_PREFIXES (servicios, ciudades, proveedor/, categoria/, comunidad, empleos) — /proveedor/ URL with localStorage cleared correctly detects 'es' even when navigator.language is en-US. (c) Sitemap regression: 9090 xhtml:link annotations emitted, '/' appears once with x-default hreflang only — matches spec. (d) ShareLinkCard.fullUrl = '/provider/${slug}' confirmed. (e) ProviderOnboarding signup redirect now navigates to /provider/${data.slug}, ProviderDashboard view-public-ecard now links to /provider/${profile.slug}. (f) /services/cleaning/sallisaw correctly renders English h1 'Cleaning in Sallisaw, OK' + English intro. (g) /services index renders English h1 'All services on getamano'. STILL BROKEN: (1) 3 broken /services/${provider.slug} refs remain in components/ShareECardBlock.jsx:21, components/QuickActionsFAB.jsx:109, components/ECardFloatingHeader.jsx:56 — these build share/copy/review URLs of the form ${origin}/services/${provider?.slug} that, when clicked or shared, navigate to a 'Categoría no encontrada' page (confirmed live at /services/maria-cleaning-services-sallisaw-ok). Spec allowed /services/${categorySlug} only — these three reference provider slugs and must be migrated to /provider/${slug}. NEW BUG EXPOSED: og:locale appears TWICE on every page — index.html has a hardcoded <meta property="og:locale" content="es_US"> at /app/frontend/public/index.html:28 and SeoHead.jsx adds another via Helmet. On EN pages there are two tags: es_US (static, first in DOM) and en_US (Helmet, second). Crawlers reading the first occurrence will see es_US even on EN pages — defeats the SeoHead.jsx ogLocale fix. Remove the static og:locale tag from public/index.html (and likely og:title/og:description Spanish defaults too, since Helmet now manages them).

ui_bugs.component: Static index.html duplicates og:locale (and og:title, og:description)
ui_bugs.issue: /app/frontend/public/index.html line 28 has hardcoded <meta property="og:locale" content="es_US"> which is NOT removed when Helmet mounts SeoHead. Result: DOM contains two og:locale tags on every page; on EN routes (/services, /services/{cat}/{city}, /provider/{slug}) the first DOM occurrence is es_US and the second is en_US. Facebook/Twitter/Google scrapers that take the first og:locale will treat all EN pages as Spanish. Fix: remove lines 22-28 og:* defaults from public/index.html (Helmet manages them now). Same applies to og:title and og:description hardcoded Spanish in static HTML.

ui_bugs.component: Three broken /services/${provider.slug} share URL builders remain

These build URLs used by copy/share/floating-share buttons. Confirmed live: navigating to /services/maria-cleaning-services-sallisaw-ok shows 'Categoría no encontrada'. Should be /provider/${slug}.

critical_code_review_comments: ProviderECard.jsx:149 derives pathIsEn via regex /^\/(provider|services)\//. Including 'services' in the EN-path check is fine for SEO but redundant since /services/{slug} is no longer routed to ProviderECard (only /provider/{slug}, /proveedor/{slug}, /p/{slug}). Consider tightening to /^\/provider\// to avoid future confusion.
I18nContext.jsx ES_PATH_PREFIXES correctly added at same priority as EN — confirmed working.

Hardcoded og:* meta tags in public/index.html duplicate React Helmet output. This is a common Helmet pitfall: react-helmet-async only injects new tags, it does not delete pre-existing ones from the static HTML. Move all dynamic OG/Twitter tags exclusively into SeoHead.

Three components still build share URLs against the legacy /services/{provider-slug} path that no longer routes to an eCard. Without a single source of truth (e.g., a getProviderUrl(slug, lang) helper in lib/seoUrls.js), this kind of regression will recur.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Two remaining fixes needed: (A) delete og:* / twitter:* hardcoded meta lines from /app/frontend/public/index.html so Helmet is the sole source. After fix, verify with: await page.evaluate('Array.from(document.querySelectorAll("meta[property=og:locale]")).map(m=>m.content)') — should return exactly one entry per page, en_US on EN, es_US on ES. (B) sed-replace the 3 share-URL builders: ShareECardBlock.jsx:21, QuickActionsFAB.jsx:109, ECardFloatingHeader.jsx:56 to use /provider/${slug}. After fix re-verify: navigate to /services/{any-provider-slug} should not be reachable from any in-app button or copy action. Sitemap, detectInitialLang, ProviderECard canonical, and EN /services pages are all confirmed working — no need to retest those.
rca of the issue: The two remaining bugs share a single root cause: 'incomplete sweep when the route map changed'. When /services/{slug}→ProviderECard was removed and SEO hubs added, only the obvious code paths (App.js routes, useNavigate calls, <Link to=...>) were updated. Two passive surfaces were missed: (1) static HTML defaults in public/index.html which exist outside the React tree and were never reconciled with the new dynamic SeoHead behavior, (2) three string-template URL builders inside Share/Copy/QuickActions components that produce outbound URLs rather than internal navigation — these are easy to miss with grep because they look like 'origin/services/x' rather than 'to=/services/x'. Mitigation: introduce lib/seoUrls.js helpers (buildProviderUrl, buildShareUrl) and forbid raw template URLs via ESLint custom rule; and eliminate static OG meta tags from index.html as a default project convention when using Helmet.
